_comment: Baseline values and timing policy for the Phase 1 smoke regression.
Frame builders read the 'nominal' and 'stimulus' sections - test modules must not
hard-code cell or pack values. 'fault_injection' holds the deliberate out-of-range
stimulus used by REG-FAULT-001/002 so future boundary testing only edits this file.

nominal._temperature_note: Reserved. There is no CAN path for temperature in this firmware: pack temperatures come from the on-board NTCs on ADC1, so this value is NOT injected in V1.

stimulus._period_note: CAN1/CAN2 RX is polled from the 100 ms task and reads all five vAFE mailboxes per pass. A 50 ms burst period leaves margin so every vAFE cycle publishes once per 100 ms pass.
